'''Balta-Trabaat''' was the manufacturer of the [[BT310 Quadra/Legends|BT310 Quadra]] [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]], a notable example of which was used by [[Ben Quadinaros/Legends|Ben Quadinaros]] in the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].
